The '''TIE/gt (ground-targeting) starfighter''' was a ground-targeting [[Bomber/Legends|bomber]] manufactured by [[Sienar Fleet Systems/Legends|Sienar Fleet Systems]].

==Characteristics==
The TIE/gt (ground-targeting) starfighter was part of the [[TIE series/Legends|TIE Series]] of [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] manufactured by [[Sienar Fleet Systems/Legends|Sienar Fleet Systems]].<ref name="ISB" /> Physically similar to the standard [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/LN starfighter]] with a ball cockpit and hexagonal solar power panels, the TIE/gt had an enlarged<ref name="SWSB" /> and reinforced hull, as well as an elongated cockpit to accommodate the [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter's]] ordnance bay.<ref name="SW" />

The TIE/gt was armed with a single [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannon]], and a [[Concussion missile launcher/Legends|concussion missile launcher]]<ref name="SWSB" /> which was designed to be modular<ref name="SW" /> to handle variable mission payloads.<ref name="ISB" /> Standard TIE/gt fighter payloads consisted of twelve [[Concussion missile/Legends|concussion missiles]], but the launcher could handle other speciality payloads, including six [[Proton torpedo/Legends|proton torpedoes]], eighteen air-deployed [[Mine/Legends|mines]], two [[Cluster bomb/Legends|cluster bombs]], or 20,000 [[Plastic/Legends|plastic]] leaflets<ref name="J10" /> for use during propaganda campaigns.<ref name="SW" />

TIE/gt fighters achieved precise targeting by operating alongside [[TIE/fc starfighter]]s, which provided the bombers with pinpoint target information.<ref name="SW" /> Larger targets, such as buildings<ref name="J10" /> or [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ships]]<ref name="SW" /> could be hit without external assistance.<ref name="J10" />

==History==
The TIE/gt fighter was a ground support bomber used by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during its early [[Standard year/Legends|years]]; its two-letter identification suffix came from its primary role as a ground-targeting starfighter/bomber.<ref name="SW">{{DB|starship|tiegtfighter|TIE/gt fighter}}</ref> Originally, TIE bomber [[Squadron/Legends|squadrons]] were comprised of TIE/gt models, but following the introduction of the [[TIE/sa tactical bomber/Legends|TIE/sa bomber]], mixed model squadrons became common. The [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] began a program of transferring TIE/gts out of naval squadrons, and relegating them either to remote outposts, or to [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]] controlled [[Ground support wing|ground support squadrons]]. However, the Imperial Army resisted the Navy's overtures due to the fighter's undesirability and the lack of genuine demand.<ref name="J10" />

Squadrons assigned to [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyers]] largely purged TIE/gts from their flightlines,<ref name="J10" /> although low-priority vessels still retained their TIE/gts.<ref name="EGVV">''[[The Essential Guide to Vehicles and Vessels]]''</ref>

TIE/gts were deployed in the [[Nishr Suppression]] by [[Governor-General/Legends|Governor-General]] [[Vin Kollis]], where they bombed three major cities on the continent of [[Feldt]].<ref name="ROE">''[[Rules of Engagement: The Rebel SpecForce Handbook]]''</ref>

Some gts, considered "newer models" in [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]], were perhaps among the defenses of [[Purdy M. Trico]]'s [[Crynyd|Star Destroyer]], as [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] thought he spotted one during the [[battle in the Milagro system]].<ref name="Dark Forces: Jedi Knight">''[[Dark Forces: Jedi Knight]]''</ref>
